## Combo 1601-1636-1806-3002

Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite storm count; Infinite untap of creatures
Start: Illuminor Szeras (battlefield); Eternal Scourge (battlefield); Intruder Alarm (battlefield); Rest in Peace (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
  Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {B}{B}{B}.
  Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
  Cast Eternal Scourge from your graveyard by paying {3}.
  Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
  Repeat.

## Combo 1619-2034-4605-5542-6143
Cards: Preston, the Vanisher + Delney, Streetwise Lookout + Sefris of the Hidden Ways + Ashnod's Altar + Feywild Caretaker
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite Treasure tokens; Infinite card draw; Infinite colored mana; Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite death triggers; Infinite draw triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss; Put all basic lands from your library into your hand; Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield; Return most creature cards from your graveyard onto the battlefield
Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Delney, Streetwise Lookout (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Ashnod's Altar (battlefield); Feywild Caretaker (graveyard)
Prerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
Steps: Complete a dungeon.
  Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
  When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
  Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
  Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
  Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Start: Rot Hulk (hand); Godhead of Awe (battlefield); Urborg Shambler (battlefield); Vindictive Lich (graveyard)
Prerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
Steps: Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
  Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
  Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
  Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
  The Vindictive Lich and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
  Resolve the Vindictive Lich trigger, causing target opponent to lose five life.
  Repeat from step 4.

## Combo 2728-2921-4153-7957
Cards: Genestealer Patriarch + Bartolomé del Presidio + Resourceful Defense + Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Genestealer Patriarch (battlefield); Bartolomé del Presidio (battlefield); Resourceful Defense (battlefield); Rikku, Resourceful Guardian (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
  An opponent controls a creature.
  Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
  You control at least two additional creatures.
Steps: Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
  Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
  Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
  When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
  Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
  Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
  Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
  Repeat from step 4.

  If the player attempts to draw from an empty library, they lose the game.
  If they didn't lose the game, the player will attempt to draw a card during their draw step and lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.
  Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.

## Combo 670-1430-1619-1974
Cards: Sefris of the Hidden Ways + Radiant Solar + Mirror Image + Quicksilver Gargantuan
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Mirror Image (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Quicksilver Gargantuan (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Mirror Image each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Evil Twin (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Synth Infiltrator (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Evil Twin each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

## Combo 824-2292-2728-4153
Cards: Genestealer Patriarch + Viscera Seer + Leech Bonder + Resourceful Defense
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {U}
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite scry 1
Start: Genestealer Patriarch (battlefield); Viscera Seer (battlefield); Leech Bonder (battlefield); Resourceful Defense (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
  An opponent controls a creature.
  Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
  You control at least two additional creatures.
Steps: Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
  Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
  Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
  When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
  Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
  Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
  Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
  Repeat from step 4.

  Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
  You control at least two additional creatures.
Steps: Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
  Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
  Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
  When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
  Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
  Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
  Resolve the Yahenni ability.
  Repeat from step 4.

  Repeat.
